## Description {#description}

Students deploy models on Linux edge devices that sit close to the sensors and
people that use the results, so memory, power, and response time limit the
design. The path pairs Volume I chapters with experiments on a Raspberry Pi.

The companion book's
[weekly lab sequence](https://mjrovai.github.io/EdgeML_Made_Ease_ebook/weekly_labs.html)
offers one possible order. Each experiment needs a test run on the classroom
hardware before it is assigned.

## Status {#status}

The path has no semester syllabus yet. The [Edge AI course page](https://mlsysbook.ai/courses/edge-ai/)
lists courses at other institutions.
